text: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport (according to the Nationality Law of The People's Republic of China), and the conditions set by the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC should be met; be in good health and get good grades. 2. Applicants must abide by the laws and regulations of the Chinese government and local government as well as the regulations of SWUFE. 3. Applicants' education background should meet one of the conditions below: (1) Nation-recognized senior high school students who will graduate in the current year must obtain a nation-recognized corresponding diploma before enrolling in the year of admission, otherwise, the admission qualification will be invalid. (2) Applicants have had a nation-recognized senior high school diploma. (3) Applicants have had a Bachelor's degree. 4. Age Limit: 18 to 35 years old. 5. Requirements for Language Proficiency A. Applicants whose native language is English, or can provide proof of studying in a 2-year or above degree program in which the teaching language is English, do not need to provide a language certificate. B. Applicants whose native language is not English are required to provide a score report of an English language test (IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 80 / Duolingo 105 / EF B2 and above) or pass the test organized by College of International Education, SWUFE. 6. Application Remarks A. Applicants for English-taught programs must select the English language version of the CSCA test. B. For English-taught programs, only the "Mathematics" subject is required. C. The Professional Chinese Test of CSCA is divided into two categories: Humanities Chinese and STEM Chinese. The test covers subjects corresponding to your intended major (Please check SWUFE 2026 Academic Program List, download here ). Notes: To ensure a smooth application process, we recommend taking the CSCA as early as possible and submitting your scores promptly to allow ample time for subsequent review. Before the CSCA exam, applicants may submit only the successful exam registration page as a reference.
